App band... iPad pe Zerodha khola... ye raha mera actual return. Live. ... Ab scene samjho. Do saal pehle aapne market mein sau rupaye daale the. Aaj khologe, toh kismat achhi hui toh ek sau chaar, ek sau paanch rupaye milenge. FD bhi isse zyada de deti. Aur ye sirf aapke saath nahi hua. Aaj main apni poori strategy kholke rakh dunga. Isi type ki cheezon ke liye bahut saare influencers hazaaron-lakhon ke courses bechte hain. Par aap sab ke liye, ye bilkul free. Aur isme koi rocket science nahi hai. Poori baat data pe hogi. Video end tak dekhna, kyunki last mein bataunga ki ye saara kaam main AI se do minute mein kaise karta hoon.

Step one. Main sirf wo companies pick karta hoon jo apni book value se neeche trade kar rahi hoti hain. Ab aap kahoge, book value hota kya hai? Simple bhasha mein: company aaj apna saara saamaan, factory sab bech de, saara karz chuka de, toh last mein jo paisa bachega, wahi book value hai. Usko total shares se divide karo, mil gayi book value per share. Ek example se samjho: aapke ghar ki keemat pachaas lakh hai, aur tees lakh ka loan baaki hai. Toh aapki asli value hai bees lakh. Ab koi wahi ghar aapko pandrah lakh mein de de, toh wo sale hai na? Ab socho. Share ka price book value se kam hai, matlab market mein wo company apni asli keemat se bhi sasti trade kar rahi hai. Literally sale lagi hai.

Par sasta hona kaafi nahi hai. Bahut saari companies isliye sasti hain kyunki unka business hi doob raha hai. Toh step two: is list mein se main sirf wo companies rakhta hoon jinka last quarter ka result pichhle teen saal mein sabse best ho. Best matlab, teen saal ka sabse highest. Matlab sasti bhi, aur business abhi apne peak pe. Ye combo rare hai, aur yahi game hai. Haan, thoda heavy lag raha hoga. Chill, end mein AI wala shortcut aa raha hai.

Ab sabse important step, aur ye koi software nahi karega. Ye aapka dimaag karega. Main bas ek sawaal poochta hoon: kya ye company agle teen-chaar saal survive karegi, aur apni growth maintain kar paayegi? Example: CIAN Agro. Is company ke quarterly results achhe aa rahe hain, growth bhi dikh rahi hai. Par mera personal view ye hai ki iska kaafi hissa sentiment aur hype pe chal raha hai. Agar kal maahaul ya govt badli, toh mujhe lagta hai share bahut tez gir sakta hai. Mujhe iske fundamentals pe khud doubt hai, isliye main CIAN Agro mein invest nahi karunga. Ye meri apni soch hai, company ke baare mein koi final verdict nahi. ... Ab ulta example: PSU banks. Kai PSU banks apni book value ke aas paas trade kar rahe hain. Aur mera maanna hai, agle das saal bhi banking band nahi hogi. India ki income badhegi, log zyada kamayenge, zyada kharchenge, aur paisa bank mein hi rakhenge. Yahan mera sawaal kitna badhega nahi hai. Sawaal sirf ye hai: kya ye tikega? Aur jawab haan hai.

Company mil gayi. Ab sabse bada sawaal: khareedna kab, aur bechna kab? Main khareedta tab hoon jab saari conditions tick ho jaayein, aur share book value se neeche ho. Bechne ke mere do simple rules hain. Rule one: jis din maine khareeda, uske chhe mahine ke andar agar share book value tak pahunch gaya ya cross kar gaya, toh main profit book kar leta hoon. Seedha. Rule two: agar chhe mahine mein book value tak nahi pahuncha, toh main hold karta hoon, aur tab bechta hoon jab price book value ka double ho jaaye. Matlab book value sau, toh target do sau. Bas. Aur ek pro tip: book value har chhe mahine mein update hoti hai, jab company apni balance sheet deti hai. Toh main apna target bhi har chhe mahine pe update karta hoon.

Ab honest baat. Har sasta share achha nahi hota. Kuch companies saalon tak book value se neeche hi padi rehti hain. Isko value trap kehte hain, aur step three isi se bachata hai. ... Toh quick recap. Ek: book value se neeche wali companies. Do: jinka last quarter teen saal mein sabse best. Teen: khud socho, ye tikegi ya nahi. Chaar: chhe mahine mein book value, warna book value ka double. Bas. Yahi poora system hai.
